sentence_1_it: Ho provato a chiamare il signor Smith, ma la linea era occupata.
sentence_1_en: I tried to call Mr Smith, but the line was busy.

sentence_1_en: In Beijing, hutongs are alleys formed by lines of siheyuans, the traditional courtyard residences.
sentence_2_it: Le linee blu sulla piantina corrispondono ai fiumi.
sentence_2_en: The blue lines on the map correspond to rivers.

sentence_3_en: The red lines on the map represent railways.
